verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools 'explore experiments, and access your Statsig data', plus a versioned Console CRUD API with a public OpenAPI spec, so an agent can read experiment configurations programmatically. Programmatic retrieval of experiment results (metric lifts, confidence intervals) is only implied, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an API/MCP tool returning experiment results or scorecard metrics, documented agent workflows for summarizing outcomes and recommending ship/rollback, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
reports metric lifts with confidence intervals
